name: 利用目的の複数ピル選択
prompt: Correct only the surface styling of the existing LH06-0032 Japanese multi-select purpose step at a 390×168 display frame. Reference 1 is the original source for pill geometry and control anatomy. Reference 2 is authoritative for the exact Japanese heading, six labels, order, layout and the two selected choices. Reference 3 is the current candidate to correct while preserving its composition. Keep the white canvas, heading 「どのように使いますか？」, exactly six pills in the same two rows and positions, and these exact labels: 「共同作業」「制作」「資料の整理」「共有」「作業の見直し」「その他」. Keep only 「資料の整理」 and 「共有」 selected. Change those two selected pills to the Lighthouse forest-green brand gradient (#174C36 at 0%, #1F6444 at 58%, #2D8F5E at 100%) with clear white text. Make all four unselected pills white with quiet neutral outlines and dark text; remove the warm beige fills. Preserve pill shape, typography, label sizing, spacing, alignment, crop and frame. Do not change copy or state, add content, add outer margins or decoration, or tint the white canvas. Output only this component on a pure white background.
